mechanic.synopsis_text: 云海之上的高山哨所时代——各代守台人以决斗传承哨位。 The setting is 云岭哨台，直径 16m 的圆形石台与祭坛铜钟，云海翻涌于台下。. 玩家是挑战者，以老哨约之名挑战现任哨卫剑士；胜者守台、败者下山。 Core loop: 观察劈砍前摇 → 方向格挡 → 抓住反击窗口 → 循环至剑士倒下。. 失败=让出哨位传承；结局表达见 §10 C02——胜者插剑立台、钟声送败者退场。 Narrative devices: 仪式攻击（背靠背转身射击）=老哨约最后的「火与剑」之约；铜钟=仪式开始与结束的见证。全部原创。. Art direction: 高山石质写实风；主色=花岗岩灰 #8E8A82、仪式红 #9E3B32、冷金 #C9A876、云白 #E8E6E0；材质为风化花岗岩、粗麻旗布、黄铜。. Sound direction: 高山风环境声为底；音效语言=剑刃轨迹+金属铿锵+钟声；关键声音优先级：剑士前摇 > 钟声 > 风。. Asset tasks: 6 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 2 tpose, 9 motion, 11 audio, 3 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
mechanic.scoring_protocol: C2按canonical等级S冻结8项，各一个scored subcheck，端点等权。其他七列沿用原冻结断言；原core12和全量来源不变。引用上下文不增加分母。这是分级核心子集，不宣称完整需求覆盖；新attempt的静态存在与运行政策另行冻结。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; attack→LMB; attack→RMB/方向键; interact→后/Space; attack→T; pause→Esc) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#G:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

asset_slot.synopsis_text: 云海之上的高山哨所时代——各代守台人以决斗传承哨位。 The setting is 云岭哨台，直径 16m 的圆形石台与祭坛铜钟，云海翻涌于台下。. 玩家是挑战者，以老哨约之名挑战现任哨卫剑士；胜者守台、败者下山。 Core loop: 观察劈砍前摇 → 方向格挡 → 抓住反击窗口 → 循环至剑士倒下。. 失败=让出哨位传承；结局表达见 §10 C02——胜者插剑立台、钟声送败者退场。 Narrative devices: 仪式攻击（背靠背转身射击）=老哨约最后的「火与剑」之约；铜钟=仪式开始与结束的见证。全部原创。. Art direction: 高山石质写实风；主色=花岗岩灰 #8E8A82、仪式红 #9E3B32、冷金 #C9A876、云白 #E8E6E0；材质为风化花岗岩、粗麻旗布、黄铜。. Sound direction: 高山风环境声为底；音效语言=剑刃轨迹+金属铿锵+钟声；关键声音优先级：剑士前摇 > 钟声 > 风。. Asset tasks: 6 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 2 tpose, 9 motion, 11 audio, 3 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
asset_slot.scoring_protocol: 本版本机制 C2 固定十二项、项间等权，每项仅一个可计分判定；引用上下文不再展开为额外评分原子。未选中的 general_requirement 规则不属于本版本 C2 分母；其他维度保留原有验收项。这是核心机制子集协议，不宣称覆盖完整需求；与历史全量协议分开报告。每行是一个验收终点，binding.subchecks 为必须独立取证的冻结细则，不是额外主项。全部主项及 CH 由同一配置的 VLM 判断；不使用 human.only 或人工回退。子检查角色为 precondition/action/behavior/boundary/recovery。precondition/action 是取证门槛，不计功能完成分。每个子检查只能 PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN；任何必需子检查 UNKNOWN 或取证门槛 FAIL，主项 UNKNOWN。门槛全部通过后，仅按 behavior/boundary/recovery 的 PASS 数/冻结可计分子检查数计算；全通过 PASS、全失败 FAIL，其余 PARTIAL。UNKNOWN/ERROR 不记零分、不缩减冻结分母；仅报告 provisional 和证据覆盖率。补采所缺场景/事件/精确数值或实际模态证据后 VLM 重评；证据仍不足继续 UNKNOWN。代码与声明不能单独证明玩法完成。C2 必须有触发条件、实际操作、结果及拒绝/恢复分支证据。仅在输入已执行且观察窗口完整时才能判失败；环境/评估器故障为 ERROR。C1 故事事实；C2 机制行为；C3 可替换接口；Q 白模构图、比例与占位模型可读性；G 玩家理解与决策；P 首次构建启动稳定性。同一事实只归一个主维度；同源不同事实可分别取证。最终资产导入播放、事件绑定质量留 Track C。先按行等权计算 C1/C2/C3，再 C=mean(C1,C2,C3)，Overall=mean(C,Q,G,P)；CH 不参与。白模允许简图、文字、几何体及占位反馈，不能以缺少最终资产判 FAIL。Q 不评价最终拓扑、材质或精细建模；P 不等于全流程通关，完整游玩闭环还需结合 C2/G 及实际试验覆盖。数值、优先级、例外和实现自由度以 general_requirement.txt 为准，引用上下文不单独计分。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; attack→LMB; attack→RMB/方向键; interact→后/Space; attack→T; pause→Esc) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

selection.title: 方向格挡：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 格挡方向与攻击来向匹配 → 0 伤害、体力 −10、开启 0.8s 反击窗口；不匹配 → 按攻击伤害受击

selection.title: 方向格挡：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 破防期格挡被拒绝；体力不足格挡仍可按（消耗后可能触发破防条件）

selection.title: 破防：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 破防 3s（不可格挡、受伤 ×1.5）；剑士获得「抓住破绽」追击表现

selection.title: 反击窗口：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 反击命中 → 剑士 −45；窗口外 LMB → 普通攻击 −20

selection.title: 反击窗口：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 窗口结束后按键走普通攻击

selection.title: 完美格挡（新增）：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 完美格挡=0 体力消耗、0.35s 顿帧、0.25s 慢动作、剑士短硬直 0.5s（可接反击）

selection.title: 背靠背转身射击仪式攻击（新增）：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 双方背靠背锁定（触发瞬间按 §10 C03 播放仪式攻击视频，每局一次，播放期间倒计时冻结）→ 3 步踱步（每步 1s，共 3s）→ 第 3 步落地开启 0.5s 转身射击窗口 → 窗口内 LMB：命中=直接获胜；未中=剑士反击 45 伤害；仪式期间玩家免受普通攻击

selection.title: 剑士攻击（系统）：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 按 G02 前摇 0.7s（可辨预告动作）→ 判定帧（30 伤害，受 G03 格挡裁决）→ 间隔 2.5s

selection.title: 暂停冻结与继续
selection.expectation: 暂停覆盖层打开，剑士攻击序列、计时、体力全部冻结

selection.title: 成功终局
selection.expectation: - V01 成功条件：剑士 HP0（含仪式射击命中直接获胜）→ 胜利结算，显示用时/剩余 HP/完美格挡数。

selection.title: 失败或非失败边界
selection.expectation: - V02 失败条件：玩家 HP0 或 180s 超时 → 失败结算并注明原因。

selection.title: 原生恢复与重新开始
selection.expectation: - V03 恢复语义：重开=全量重置（HP/体力/序列相位/仪式次数/计时）；Esc 暂停可继续。

context.C01:
- C01 仪式开场（Opening，8 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：首次由标题进入决斗之前，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：云岭哨台晨光，祭坛铜钟被敲响三声；决斗者拾阶登台，与哨卫剑士相对行礼，拔刀出鞘映出云海
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、石台、铜钟与游戏内模型同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入决斗；自然播完 → 进入决斗
  - 状态一致：播放期间不推进计时
context.C02:
- C02 哨台易主（Ending，10 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：胜负结算面板出现之前，每局一次（胜负共用，内容含双意象）
  - 内容与角色场景：胜者将长刀插立台心，钟声送响；败者收刀踉跄步下石阶，云雾漫过台缘
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、石台与游戏内同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入结算面板；播完 → 进入结算面板
  - 状态一致：仅在真实 V01/V02 后触发
context.C03:
- C03 火与剑之约（Event，7 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：玩家按 T 发起仪式、`ritual_start` 事件触发瞬间，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：决斗者与哨卫剑士收刀背靠背立于台心，镜头低角度环绕二人；风声渐弱、心跳渐强，二人沿直线各走出三步，衣摆与旗布翻卷；第 3 步落地震起尘土，二人握住燧发枪柄蓄势待转
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、燧发枪、石台与游戏内模型同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入踱步第 1 步（仪式继续、状态一致）；自然播完 → 进入踱步第 1 步
  - 状态一致：仅在真实满足 M05 前置（每局 1 次、体力 ≥30、距离 ≤3m）后触发；播放期间 180s 倒计时冻结、双方免受攻击，播放结束瞬间进入踱步序列

  - 内容与角色场景：云岭哨台晨光，祭坛铜钟被敲响三声；决斗者拾阶登台，与哨卫剑士相对行礼，拔刀出鞘映出云海
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、石台、铜钟与游戏内模型同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入决斗；自然播完 → 进入决斗
  - 状态一致：播放期间不推进计时
context.C02:
- C02 哨台易主（Ending，10 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：胜负结算面板出现之前，每局一次（胜负共用，内容含双意象）
  - 内容与角色场景：胜者将长刀插立台心，钟声送响；败者收刀踉跄步下石阶，云雾漫过台缘
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、石台与游戏内同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入结算面板；播完 → 进入结算面板
  - 状态一致：仅在真实 V01/V02 后触发
context.C03:
- C03 火与剑之约（Event，7 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：玩家按 T 发起仪式、`ritual_start` 事件触发瞬间，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：决斗者与哨卫剑士收刀背靠背立于台心，镜头低角度环绕二人；风声渐弱、心跳渐强，二人沿直线各走出三步，衣摆与旗布翻卷；第 3 步落地震起尘土，二人握住燧发枪柄蓄势待转
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、燧发枪、石台与游戏内模型同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入踱步第 1 步（仪式继续、状态一致）；自然播完 → 进入踱步第 1 步
  - 状态一致：仅在真实满足 M05 前置（每局 1 次、体力 ≥30、距离 ≤3m）后触发；播放期间 180s 倒计时冻结、双方免受攻击，播放结束瞬间进入踱步序列

context.M05:
- M05 背靠背转身射击仪式攻击（新增）
  - input：T（触发方：玩家发起，后续由系统驱动）
  - precondition：每局 1 次；体力 ≥30；与剑士距离 ≤3m
  - state_change：双方背靠背锁定（触发瞬间按 §10 C03 播放仪式攻击视频，每局一次，播放期间倒计时冻结）→ 3 步踱步（每步 1s，共 3s）→ 第 3 步落地开启 0.5s 转身射击窗口 → 窗口内 LMB：命中=直接获胜；未中=剑士反击 45 伤害；仪式期间玩家免受普通攻击
  - observable：`ritual_start` / `ritual_step(1..3)` / `ritual_window` / `ritual_hit` / `ritual_miss` 事件；C03 播放起止事件
  - invalid_case：踱步中 Esc=取消仪式（消耗 10 体力）；窗口内未按 LMB=未中
  - recovery：每局仅一次；取消后本局不可再发起

LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#G:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

gameness.synopsis_text: 云海之上的高山哨所时代——各代守台人以决斗传承哨位。 The setting is 云岭哨台，直径 16m 的圆形石台与祭坛铜钟，云海翻涌于台下。. 玩家是挑战者，以老哨约之名挑战现任哨卫剑士；胜者守台、败者下山。 Core loop: 观察劈砍前摇 → 方向格挡 → 抓住反击窗口 → 循环至剑士倒下。. 失败=让出哨位传承；结局表达见 §10 C02——胜者插剑立台、钟声送败者退场。 Narrative devices: 仪式攻击（背靠背转身射击）=老哨约最后的「火与剑」之约；铜钟=仪式开始与结束的见证。全部原创。. Art direction: 高山石质写实风；主色=花岗岩灰 #8E8A82、仪式红 #9E3B32、冷金 #C9A876、云白 #E8E6E0；材质为风化花岗岩、粗麻旗布、黄铜。. Sound direction: 高山风环境声为底；音效语言=剑刃轨迹+金属铿锵+钟声；关键声音优先级：剑士前摇 > 钟声 > 风。. Asset tasks: 6 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 2 tpose, 9 motion, 11 audio, 3 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
gameness.scoring_protocol: 白模主评分配额 S30/M55/L-Regular80/L-Stress105；CH 诊断另列。每行是一个验收终点，binding.subchecks 为必须独立取证的冻结细则，不是额外主项。全部主项及 CH 由同一配置的 VLM 判断；不使用 human.only 或人工回退。每个子检查只能 PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN；所有子检查均有结论时，全部通过=PASS，全部失败=FAIL，其余为 PARTIAL，分数=通过子检查数/冻结子检查数。任一 UNKNOWN 则主项 UNKNOWN。UNKNOWN/ERROR 不记零分、不缩减冻结分母；仅报告 provisional 和证据覆盖率。补采所缺场景/事件/精确数值或实际模态证据后 VLM 重评；证据仍不足继续 UNKNOWN。代码与声明不能单独证明玩法完成。C2 必须有触发条件、实际操作、结果及拒绝/恢复分支证据。仅在输入已执行且观察窗口完整时才能判失败；环境/评估器故障为 ERROR。C1 故事事实；C2 机制行为；C3 可替换接口；Q 白模构图、比例与占位模型可读性；G 玩家理解与决策；P 首次构建启动稳定性。同一事实只归一个主维度；同源不同事实可分别取证。最终资产导入播放、事件绑定质量留 Track C。先按行等权计算 C1/C2/C3，再 C=mean(C1,C2,C3)，Overall=mean(C,Q,G,P)；CH 不参与。白模允许简图、文字、几何体及占位反馈，不能以缺少最终资产判 FAIL。Q 不评价最终拓扑、材质或精细建模；P 不等于全流程通关，完整游玩闭环还需结合 C2/G 及实际试验覆盖。数值、优先级、例外和实现自由度以 general_requirement.txt 为准，引用上下文不单独计分。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (move→WASD; attack→LMB; attack→RMB/方向键; interact→后/Space; attack→T; pause→Esc) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

context.F05:
- F05 事件反馈表（冻结需求）：

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 格挡成功 | 兵器碰撞火花+0.1s 顿帧 | 金属铿锵 | 顿帧结束 |
| 完美格挡 | 白闪+0.35s 顿帧+0.25s 慢动作 | 完美格挡清鸣 | 慢动作结束 |
| 玩家受击 | 受击顿帧+红色边缘 | 受击闷响 | 0.3s |
| 破防 | 剑士失衡前倾+镜头推近 5% | 破防重音 | 3s 解除 |
| 反击命中 | 剑刃轨迹+剑士后退 | 剑刃重击 | 0.3s |
| 仪式踱步 | 心跳脉动 UI | 心跳渐强（3 步） | 第 3 步落地 |
| 仪式射击 | 枪口火光+镜头后坐 2° | 燧发枪声 | 0.5s 窗口结束 |
| 剑士倒下 | 插剑/倒地动画+云海光变 | 胜利钟声 | 进入结算 |
| 失败 | 画面降饱和 | 低沉风声 | 进入面板 |
context.M01:
- M01 方向格挡
  - input：RMB 按住 + 方向键（触发方：玩家）
  - precondition：非破防期；处于决斗状态
  - state_change：格挡方向与攻击来向匹配 → 0 伤害、体力 −10、开启 0.8s 反击窗口；不匹配 → 按攻击伤害受击
  - observable：`block(dir)` / `block_fail` 事件与体力快照
  - invalid_case：破防期格挡被拒绝；体力不足格挡仍可按（消耗后可能触发破防条件）
  - recovery：松开 RMB 结束格挡姿态
context.M05:
- M05 背靠背转身射击仪式攻击（新增）
  - input：T（触发方：玩家发起，后续由系统驱动）
  - precondition：每局 1 次；体力 ≥30；与剑士距离 ≤3m
  - state_change：双方背靠背锁定（触发瞬间按 §10 C03 播放仪式攻击视频，每局一次，播放期间倒计时冻结）→ 3 步踱步（每步 1s，共 3s）→ 第 3 步落地开启 0.5s 转身射击窗口 → 窗口内 LMB：命中=直接获胜；未中=剑士反击 45 伤害；仪式期间玩家免受普通攻击
  - observable：`ritual_start` / `ritual_step(1..3)` / `ritual_window` / `ritual_hit` / `ritual_miss` 事件；C03 播放起止事件
  - invalid_case：踱步中 Esc=取消仪式（消耗 10 体力）；窗口内未按 LMB=未中
  - recovery：每局仅一次；取消后本局不可再发起
context.S07:
- S07 决斗
  - input：WASD 移动、LMB 攻击、RMB+方向 格挡、后+Space 撤步、T 仪式攻击、Esc（触发方：玩家）；剑士攻击由 seed 序列驱动（触发方：系统）
  - precondition：处于决斗状态
  - state_change：按 §6 M01–M05 结算每次输入；HP/体力/反击窗口实时更新
  - feedback：命中与格挡反馈按 §9 F05（火花/铿锵/顿帧/慢镜）
  - next_actions：任一方 HP0 →「胜负结算」；180s 超时 →「失败结算」
  - outcome：按 V01/V02 判定
context.S10:
- S10 暂停
  - input：Esc（触发方：玩家）

context.G07: - G07 优先级与同帧裁决：同帧「格挡指令按下 0.15s 内的攻击命中」按 M04 完美格挡结算；反击窗口最后一帧与下一剑士攻击同帧 → 玩家动作先结算；180s 归零瞬间已有判定帧在飞 → 该帧结算后再判超时。

  - observable：`perfect_parry` 事件
  - invalid_case：超过 0.15s 的命中按普通格挡结算

context.C03:
- C03 火与剑之约（Event，7 秒，1280×720@24fps）
  - 触发时机：玩家按 T 发起仪式、`ritual_start` 事件触发瞬间，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：决斗者与哨卫剑士收刀背靠背立于台心，镜头低角度环绕二人；风声渐弱、心跳渐强，二人沿直线各走出三步，衣摆与旗布翻卷；第 3 步落地震起尘土，二人握住燧发枪柄蓄势待转
  - 资产对应：决斗者、剑士、燧发枪、石台与游戏内模型同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入踱步第 1 步（仪式继续、状态一致）；自然播完 → 进入踱步第 1 步
  - 状态一致：仅在真实满足 M05 前置（每局 1 次、体力 ≥30、距离 ≤3m）后触发；播放期间 180s 倒计时冻结、双方免受攻击，播放结束瞬间进入踱步序列

context.G03: - G03 格挡与破防：方向格挡（RMB+方向键）——方向与攻击来向匹配=格挡成功（0 伤害、体力 −10）；不匹配=受击（HP −30）。受击时体力 <20 → 破防：3s 内不可格挡且受伤 ×1.5（=45）。

  - input：LMB（触发方：玩家）
  - precondition：格挡成功后 0.8s 内
  - state_change：反击命中 → 剑士 −45；窗口外 LMB → 普通攻击 −20
  - observable：`counter(t)` / `attack(t)` 事件与剑士 HP 流水
  - invalid_case：窗口结束后按键走普通攻击
  - recovery：每次格挡成功刷新一次窗口
context.M04:
- M04 完美格挡（新增）
  - input：格挡指令按下后 0.15s 内的攻击命中（触发方：系统判定）
  - precondition：格挡姿态已建立
  - state_change：完美格挡=0 体力消耗、0.35s 顿帧、0.25s 慢动作、剑士短硬直 0.5s（可接反击）
  - observable：`perfect_parry` 事件
  - invalid_case：超过 0.15s 的命中按普通格挡结算
  - recovery：无额外恢复——窗口与反击规则同 M03
context.M05:
- M05 背靠背转身射击仪式攻击（新增）
  - input：T（触发方：玩家发起，后续由系统驱动）
  - precondition：每局 1 次；体力 ≥30；与剑士距离 ≤3m
  - state_change：双方背靠背锁定（触发瞬间按 §10 C03 播放仪式攻击视频，每局一次，播放期间倒计时冻结）→ 3 步踱步（每步 1s，共 3s）→ 第 3 步落地开启 0.5s 转身射击窗口 → 窗口内 LMB：命中=直接获胜；未中=剑士反击 45 伤害；仪式期间玩家免受普通攻击
  - observable：`ritual_start` / `ritual_step(1..3)` / `ritual_window` / `ritual_hit` / `ritual_miss` 事件；C03 播放起止事件
  - invalid_case：踱步中 Esc=取消仪式（消耗 10 体力）；窗口内未按 LMB=未中
  - recovery：每局仅一次；取消后本局不可再发起
context.M06:
- M06 剑士攻击（系统）
  - input：seed 序列驱动（触发方：系统）
  - precondition：决斗状态、非硬直、非仪式
  - state_change：按 G02 前摇 0.7s（可辨预告动作）→ 判定帧（30 伤害，受 G03 格挡裁决）→ 间隔 2.5s
  - observable：`windup` / `strike` 事件
  - invalid_case：完美格挡硬直 0.5s / 破防追击期间序列暂停
  - recovery：硬直结束后恢复序列

  - input：T（触发方：玩家发起，后续由系统驱动）
  - precondition：每局 1 次；体力 ≥30；与剑士距离 ≤3m

LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.evaluation_plan_table.md#Q:
| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

context.F05:
- F05 事件反馈表（冻结需求）：

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 格挡成功 | 兵器碰撞火花+0.1s 顿帧 | 金属铿锵 | 顿帧结束 |
| 完美格挡 | 白闪+0.35s 顿帧+0.25s 慢动作 | 完美格挡清鸣 | 慢动作结束 |
| 玩家受击 | 受击顿帧+红色边缘 | 受击闷响 | 0.3s |
| 破防 | 剑士失衡前倾+镜头推近 5% | 破防重音 | 3s 解除 |
| 反击命中 | 剑刃轨迹+剑士后退 | 剑刃重击 | 0.3s |
| 仪式踱步 | 心跳脉动 UI | 心跳渐强（3 步） | 第 3 步落地 |
| 仪式射击 | 枪口火光+镜头后坐 2° | 燧发枪声 | 0.5s 窗口结束 |
| 剑士倒下 | 插剑/倒地动画+云海光变 | 胜利钟声 | 进入结算 |
| 失败 | 画面降饱和 | 低沉风声 | 进入面板 |

| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |
